description: This Java class 'DefaultConnectionLimitManager' enforces and manages a limit on concurrent connections, configurable via strategy or adapter properties, with logging and auto-configuration features.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionLimitManager
classes.description: Manages connection limits based on strategy and configuration, with auto-configuration and logging.

methods.name: DefaultConnectionLimitManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the connection limit manager with strategy, current connections supplier, and optional configuration.

methods.name: autoconfigureConnectionLimit
methods.description: Determines and sets the connection limit based on strategy's recommended limit, throws exception if limit is zero.

methods.name: checkConnectionLimit
methods.description: Validates configured limit against recommended limit, logs warning if too high.

methods.name: isLimitExceeded
methods.description: Checks if current connections exceed the limit.
